title: 14 Best Email Design Software in 2026
summary: Deep dive into the review of the 14 best email design software with features, advantages, and pricing to find the right one for your email marketing stack.
body_markdown:
## 1. Mailmodo


Mailmodo was built around a single goal: to make email marketing simpler for marketers without a technical background. The platform provides multiple ways to design emails, beginning with its AI-powered template generator. You simply need to type a prompt, and the tool will create a professional looking first draft.


Once the AI template generator creates your email, you can use Mailmodo’s drag-and-drop editor to make any additional tweaks. Adjust layouts, swap images, change colors, or modify text effortlessly.


Your AI Assistant for Everything Email Marketing


**Mailmodo pricing:**


You get a 21-day free trial. There are three[paid plans](https://www.mailmodo.com/pricing/) presently:


**Plan** **Pricing starts from**


Lite $39/month


Pro $79/month


Max $159/month


**Type of editor:**


Using the[WYSIWYG email template editor](https://www.mailmodo.com/features/wysiwyg-email-editor/) , you can drag and drop pre-coded content blocks like text, images, and also AMP blocks, etc.


**Email templates available:**


It has[400+ email templates](https://www.mailmodo.com/email-templates/) for different industries and occasions. You can edit and send it out in minutes. You can also import your custom template as an AMP or HTML file.


**Export options:**


You don't have to export any template you create because you can send the email directly through the email marketing platform.


**Responsive:**


The designs and templates provided are[responsive](https://www.mailmodo.com/solutions/create-responsive-emails/) by default. So you don't have to fuss about emails not rendering well on different devices.


**Special email marketing features:**


- You can make your emails interactive by using AMP components like forms, calendars, widgets, etc.
- You can use the dynamic content to save time and automatically update the content on the emails you have created.
- You can[integrate Mailmodo with APIs and CRM tools](https://www.mailmodo.com/integrations/) like HubSpot, Zapier, Shopify, etc.
- You can A/B test your subject lines to see which one gets readers to open the email.
- You can automate and send emails on time using the email automation features.
- Before sending the email, you can preview what the email looks like on desktop and desktop.
- You can create and save content blocks and reuse it in other templates.
- You can also send a test email to yourself or your team members to check how it renders in the email client.
- You can utilize artificial intelligence to create compelling email subject lines.


### 2. Omnisend


[Omnisend](https://www.omnisend.com/) is an ecommerce-focused email and SMS marketing platform that helps online stores design, automate, and send campaigns across email, SMS, and web push from one dashboard.


**Omnisend Pricing:**


In terms of the plans that include email marketing:


Plan Price Starts From


Free $0/month


Standard $16/month


Pro $59/month


They also have an option to purchase annually rather than monthly, which you can choose if you want to get a better deal in the long run.


**Type of Editor:** It has a drag-and-drop editor that you can use to customize the email layout, product blocks, and branding.


**Templates Available:** They have 350+ email templates built around ecommerce goals like welcome series, cart recovery, and product promotions. They also pull your branding from your website to apply it automatically across every template.


**Export Options:** You don't have to export the design since you can send your emails directly within the platform. You can also import a custom-coded HTML template through their saved templates feature if you want to build outside the drag-and-drop editor.


**Responsive:** The templates are responsive by default, adapting automatically from desktop to mobile. If you are creating a custom HTML template, you'll need to check your own markup since it isn't automatically made responsive.


You can preview and send test emails to check how the template renders on different email clients.


**Special Features:**


- Omnisend connects to AI assistants and tools through its MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector, so you can manage campaigns and segments directly from an AI interface.
- They have the AI segment builder and Customer Lifecycle Map to help you send more targeted campaigns to different audiences.
- Omnisend costs up to 35% less than Klaviyo at comparable contact tiers, and stores switching over get a free 5-day guided migration for their lists and automations.
- Omnisend holds a 4.6/5 rating on G2 from ecommerce marketers who use it for email, SMS, and push automation together.

**Mailchimp pricing:**


Free lifetime and monthly paid plans are available.


Plan Pricing


Essentials $13/month


Standard $20/month


Premium $350/month


They have a pay-as-you-go plan if you are not going to be sending emails regularly.


**Type of editor:** They have two kinds of email editors: a classic builder with a drag-and-drop interface and a new builder enhanced to create designs faster.


**Templates available:** They have 100+ pre-made templates, but you can only access all of them in the paid plans. You can import your custom templates as HTML or zip.


**Export options:** You don't have to export the template; you can send emails directly through the platform.


**Responsive:** The emails you create on the platform are automatically edited to be shown on mobile. However, it might not always render well on mobile, so you have to make changes in the email to see if it renders well both on desktop and mobile. You can't manually edit your designs for mobile view.


**Special features:**


- You can use the subject line helper tool to get data-driven feedback on your subject lines to help you write a compelling subject line.
- They have a creative AI assistant that generates designs for you based on your branding.
- Dynamic content
- Landing page builder to create pages without code.

## What to consider when choosing email design software?


You need to know what you need before you get something; the same applies to choosing an email creation software. Here are some aspects you can look for when choosing one.


- **Responsive design:** Does the software allow you to create responsive designs for all devices, especially mobile?
- **Pricing:** Do they have a generous free trial/plan where you can try out the software and see if it works for you?
- **Export options:** After creating the template, do you have to export it, or can you send the email through the software itself?
- **Templates available:** How many sample templates do they provide for you to choose from? Premade templates make it easy for beginner email marketers to create and send campaigns. So best to choose software that provides plenty of pre-made templates.
- **Type of editor:** Is it a completely drag-and-drop editor, or does it require some coding knowledge to make adjustments?


For beginners, it's best to choose an email service provider (ESP) like Mailmodo, Mailchimp, etc., as creating an[email design system](https://www.mailmodo.com/ebook/email-design-system/) and sending emails all in one platform is easier.


If you are familiar with email marketing and have an easy-to-use ESP, you can check out other exclusive design software like Figma, Topol, etc. But before that, check if your ESP allows custom template import to ensure you can upload the design you create on external software.
